description.zh: 時間戳由三個數字組成：時、分、秒。給定兩個時間戳（各三行），計算兩者相差多少秒。第一個時間一定早於第二個。
description.en: A timestamp has three numbers: hours, minutes and seconds. Given two timestamps (three lines each), calculate how many seconds are between them. The first moment occurs before the second.

hint.zh: 先把每個時間戳換算成秒，再相減：h×3600 + m×60 + s
hint.en: Convert each timestamp to seconds, then subtract: h×3600 + m×60 + s
